nodes.label: La Nube Polo Tecnológico — Brand Logo (SVG)
nodes.description: Full isologo (icon + wordmark) for 'La Nube Polo Tecnológico'. Composed of two SVG groups: (1) ISOLOGO — an abstract network/cloud icon made of curved strokes representing atmospheric layers and seven circular nodes connected by lines, evoking a cloud topology or knowledge graph; nodes are colored in a palette of blues and teals (navy #1c62a3, royal #336bb3, cornflower #4189c8, sky #56c3eb, cyan #5bc1d2, aqua #91d1db, turquoise #3db7e4) with white stroke outlines; (2) LA_NUBE_POLO_TECNOLOGICO — the wordmark text in two lines: 'LA NUBE' rendered in large bold dark-blue (#1c62a3) letterforms, and 'POLO TECNOLÓGICO' rendered in smaller light-blue (#3db7e4) letterforms beneath. The viewBox is 395×156.76 px (landscape). The icon uses stroke-width 14px with rounded linecaps and miterlimit styling for smooth curves. The overall brand identity communicates a technology hub or coworking space themed around cloud computing and network connectivity.
nodes.icon_style: abstract network graph with cloud curves and circular nodes
